service_boundary: Represents the international platform operated at siliconflow.com by a Singapore entity, not the separately operated mainland platform, and not the model publishers whose weights it serves.
regional_controls: The terms state the service is unavailable to users located in mainland China and direct them to the separate mainland platform. No region parameter is documented, and personal data may be transferred within or outside Singapore.
retention_controls: The terms state the operator will not access interaction data and is under no obligation to store it, and will not use or disclose it without authorisation. Customers are prohibited from using service content for machine-learning training. Interaction data may be deleted at the operator's discretion when an account terminates.
routing: Customers select a model identifier per request. Reserved instances provide guaranteed throughput; documented routing or fallback parameters are absent from the API reference.
customization: Custom-model onboarding and private deployment are offered commercially. Fine-tuning appears as a product but is absent from this platform's documentation index.
strengths: Terms state the operator will not access interaction data and prohibit customers from using service content for model training.
One base path serves two major compatible conventions alongside native reranking, audio, and video endpoints.
Reserved and dedicated capacity are available alongside serverless access.
tradeoffs: The governing terms are materially older than the mainland platform's, and the documentation omits batch and fine-tuning pages that the mainland site publishes.
Interaction data may be deleted at the operator's discretion on account termination, and personal data may move outside Singapore.
Users located in mainland China are excluded by the terms, so this platform is not a global superset.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.

upstream_disclosure.note: The privacy policy states the operator processes interaction data: "In case the Interaction Data contains Personal Data, as a neutral technology service provider, we will only process your Interaction Data strictly in accordance with your instructions." No subprocessor is named.

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "Go to the API Keys page, click “Create API Key,” and generate your API key." and every documented request uses that key.

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching announcement describes the feature and its pricing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the account that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: SiliconFlow prompt-caching blog post, for SiliconFlow (international)

vulnerability_disclosure.note: No security contact or disclosure policy appears in the terms of service, the privacy policy, or the documentation, and no security.txt is served.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: SiliconFlow terms of service, for SiliconFlow (international)

independent_audit.note: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent attestation is named in the privacy policy, the terms, or the documentation.
